title: The last sheet can be half-used
hook: Two pages per sheet: what happens when the page count is odd?

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Compute whole-sheet needs for odd double-sided page counts.

misconception: Double-sided printing always uses exactly half a sheet per page.
objective: Compute whole-sheet needs for odd double-sided page counts.

claims.text: All pages can be printed one per side, either single-sided or on both sides. Blank final sides are allowed. Scaled model; page-count model; two printable sides/sheet.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Pages=7, A=7sheets and B=4sheets. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A="x"; B=["ceil",["/","x",2]]; x denotes Pages. At x=7, A=7, B=4; recall at x=10: B=5. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Divide pages by two and round up for double-sided sheets. An odd final page still occupies a whole sheet. The ceiling makes that partly unused final sheet visible instead of pretending it is half a physical sheet.

recall.question: All pages can be printed one per side, either single-sided or on both sides. Blank final sides are allowed. Change only Pages to 10. What is B (Double-sided) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Pages=10: it gives 5sheets. Divide pages by two and round up for double-sided sheets. An odd final page still occupies a whole sheet. The ceiling makes that partly unused final sheet visible instead of pretending it is half a physical sheet.
